resources.string: Mind-Ur-Set asks for one thing before your first check-in: permission to keep what you write on this phone.
Your check-ins, reflections and actions stay in this app\'s storage on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
You can read and delete what you wrote at any time, withdraw this permission from Data and consent, and the crisis numbers work without it.
Without this, a check-in cannot be saved. Everything else still opens.
Agree to how your data is used before the first check-in.
